# Required acknowledgement and grammar fail before any state/root mutation.
! skygo state artifacts init --data-dir untouched --artifact-dir absent
stderr 'requires --ack-writers-stopped'
! exists untouched
! exists absent
! skygo state artifacts init --data-dir untouched --ack-writers-stopped
stderr 'required flag.*artifact-dir'
! exists untouched

# The real stopped initializer and its persisted readback use no remote auth.
mkdir root
chmod 0700 root
skygo --json state artifacts init --data-dir state --artifact-dir root --ack-writers-stopped
stdout '^\{"enabled":true,"policy":"default-v1","restart_required":true\}\n$'
! stderr .
exists root/.skygo-artifact-root
exists state/jobs.db

# An installed state refuses before touching a different empty root.
mkdir other
chmod 0700 other
! skygo state artifacts init --data-dir state --artifact-dir other --ack-writers-stopped
stderr '^artifact initialization: already installed\n$'
! exists other/.skygo-artifact-root

# A nonempty operator root is not adopted or cleaned.
mkdir nonempty
chmod 0700 nonempty
cp kept.txt nonempty/kept
! skygo state artifacts init --data-dir second-state --artifact-dir nonempty --ack-writers-stopped
stderr '^artifact initialization: initialize root marker\n$'
cmp nonempty/kept kept.txt
! exists nonempty/.skygo-artifact-root

# Text readback has the same three public facts and no root identity/path.
mkdir text-root
chmod 0700 text-root
skygo state artifacts init --data-dir text-state --artifact-dir text-root --ack-writers-stopped
stdout '^enabled: true\npolicy: default-v1\nrestart_required: true\n$'
! stderr .

-- kept.txt --
original evidence
